messages.title: Community Vote: Should We Rename the Mod Manager?
messages.content: Help decide the future name and identity of the mod manager. Cast your vote on GameBanana to share your thoughts.

messages.title: Curated Recommendations
messages.content: These mods and tools are personally recommended for quality, stability, and utility. Frameworks and accessibility tweaks listed here enhance the overall game experience.

recommended_mods.reason: Essential framework mod. It removes built-in censorship meshes and provides the required shader foundation for any mods utilizing glowing textures or emissive effects.
A standalone 3DMigoto mod viewer and renderer with advanced tools, ideal for taking a deep dive into your own mods and inspecting mesh files outside the game.
Even Officer Mew Mew needs a vacation once in a while. Luckily, Chiitan is here to cover the shift.
Adjusts character outline thickness across the game. Great for achieving a bolder, more animated or comic-book aesthetic.
Clean and convenient tool for hiding on-screen UI elements, perfect for taking clean screenshots or focusing entirely on the action.
Very helpful quick-reference overlay for beginners displaying enemy weaknesses and resistances, though it has not been updated in a while.
Burger. An interactive, physics-driven jelly burger for Anby that is as fun as it sounds.
One of the most talented creators in the community. While many of her designs lean NSFW, the craftsmanship, detail, and polish are top tier.
Very clean, creative designs from Arttmadness. The creator consistently produces well-crafted models, and their recent Zhao skins are a great showcase.
Versatile inspection tool providing creative camera angles and green-screen backdrops, useful for screenshots, video edits, and showcases.
Great combat accessibility tweak that recolors the parry flash indicators, helping visual cues stand out clearly against bright particle effects.
Thoughtful accessibility overlay that repositions critical battle HUD elements closer to center view. Check out the creator's profile for other helpful tweaks.
Replaces Lucy's guard boars with Ugandan Knuckles. Why not? A fun, humorous mod that works surprisingly well in combat.
Charming Shisa-inspired reskin for Miss Esme Bangboo with lovely cultural motifs and clean textures.
Transforms Eous into the infamous Doro meme creature. Surprisingly well-animated and hilarious during exploration.
Enables interactive touch response animations for characters that normally lack them in menu screens.
A subtle and clean anatomical reshape for Soldier 0 with refined proportions and silhouette adjustments.
Well-integrated model swap bringing Vesper over Pyrois with custom animations and polished combat rigging.
Sans-inspired blue hoodie and glowing eye theme for Pan Yinhu. Simple, playful, and instantly recognizable.
An elegant, floral-inspired retexture and outfit design for Lucia with intricate lace detailing.
A sharp military-specialist tactical uniform for Grace that fits Belobog Heavy Industries' aesthetic remarkably well.
High-energy, stylized culinary combat outfit for Burnice from Selrew's popular Operation Yum series.
Turns Billy into V1/V2 from Ultrakill. Fitting gunslinger crossover with slick mechanical sound effects and models.
Hilarious Pop Team Epic face and style swap for Belle. Impossible not to smile when running around the city.
A fiery thematic overhaul for Banyue with vivid orange heat accents and glowing kettle highlights.
Cute miniature Vesper companion model swap for Aria with smooth physics and faithful scaling.
Replaces Anton with Minecraft's Steve, complete with cubic drill and voxelized textures. Pure comedic genius.
Gothic castle-maid dress overhaul for Rina featuring regal embroidery and moody dark-velvet textures.
Creative Peni Parker Spider-Verse cosplay for Qingyi, complete with custom school uniform and spider decals.
Crisp dress-uniform redesign for Jane Doe with sharp formal tailoring, gold epaulets, and sleek textures.
Casual streetwear outfit for Dialyn with oversized hoodie and urban sneaker styling suited for Sixth Street.
Dark fantasy reimagining of Caesar corrupted by Ether energy, featuring cracked crystalline textures and ominous violet hues.
Classy business-formal attire for Nicole when she wants to look responsible while negotiating with clients.
Awesome crossover importing A.B.A and Paracelsus over Piper, capturing Guilty Gear's signature style flawlessly.
Saul Goodman-inspired suit and tie for Dialyn. Essential for any Hollow Investigator facing legal trouble.
Dorofied Ju Fufu riding Hu Wei as a comedic road roller. Great animations and chaotic energy.
Equips Zhao with a green apron and barista visor. Perfect for funding his next coffee expedition.
Genshin Impact crossover swapping Corin into Noelle's armored maid dress. Natural fit for her spinning saw attacks.
Restores Caesar's early concept/beta biker design before official release tweaks. A great piece of design history.
Iconic Resident Evil 4 red cheongsam dress tailored onto Jane Doe with matching gloves and sleek textures.
Fast-food worker aesthetic for Anby from the Operation Yum series, fitting her legendary love for burgers.
Traditional martial arts robes for Yixuan with clean fabric folds and dignified monochrome palette.
Warm autumn-hued ensemble for Yixuan with falling leaf motifs and cozy seasonal textures.
Refreshes in-game character avatar and dialog portrait icons with cute, clean sticker-style illustrations.
